prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Ghanaian woman, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 40s silver fox goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white hair in an elegant updo — full body Korean Haetae guardian fire beast bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING CRIMSON orange fire beast guardian full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID GOLD mythological flame burst filling every gap, ELECTRIC RED beast detail both legs hip to toe, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A light smudge of soot marks her cheek and jawline, and a little soot dusts her fingertips, the backs of her hands and her bare feet. Her expression is a quiet, serious expression. Restraints: A heavy wooden saltire cross of two thick rough-hewn dark oak beams crossed in an X and bolted together at the center stands upright behind her, its four arms reaching out to her stretched limbs. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto the end of an upper arm of the X, and her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto the end of a lower arm of the X, the cuffs sitting snug against the dark wood, her arms and legs stretched wide apart in the shape of the X. From each of the two wrist cuffs a thick chain hangs down ending in a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball, the two balls dangling below her hands, and from each of the two ankle cuffs a thick chain runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball resting on the flagstones beside that foot, the weights pulling every limb down against the cross. Pose: standing full height with her back against the X-shaped cross, facing the camera, her arms and legs stretched wide apart in a big X with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her head tipped slightly forward, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long coffin matte nails crimson gold tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
